note: Trigger-routing suite, converted from the pre-migration corpus's scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) into harness's cases schema. Routing corpus for make-design-system v2 — the CROSS-PLATFORM HUB (recharted 2026-07-05; the v1 Claude-Design-bundle charter and its corpus moved to make-dscard-kit). Positives span the hub's four owned surfaces: (a) cross-platform strategy (which platform, port to multiple, one core for all), (b) the core+profiles architecture (canonical core, carrier equality, new platform profile), (c) generation-context potency (make prompts better, generic output, what belongs in the spine), (d) shared-doctrine questions that span platforms (naming grammar as shared vocabulary, one source of truth). Negatives are the fenced seats: the three platform siblings (named single-platform execution — author/lint/fix one export), the design-system-checker agent (grading an export), upstream makers (make-palette, check-colors, token-builder), component-checker, and prd-author. The load-bearing distinction: a named single platform + a concrete artifact routes to the sibling; spanning, unnamed, or context-layer asks route here. Renamed design-system-author -> design-system-hub 2026-07-09 per ADR-0001 (verb-form grammar); renamed again -> make-design-system 2026-07-21 per ADR-0006.
